email.verify_body:
Hello {name},

Please confirm your email to activate your account on the Ministry of Economy & Tourism careers portal.

{link}

The link works for 48 hours. If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
email.reset_body:
Hello {name},

We received a request to reset the password of your careers portal account. Choose a new password here.

{link}

The link works for one hour and can be used once. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your password stays the same.
